tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: There is established the Rio Grande Natural Area Commission.

children.text: advise the Secretary with respect to the Natural Area; and
prepare a management plan relating to non-Federal land in the Natural Area under section 460rrr–4(b)(2)(A) of this title.

tree.heading: Membership
tree.text: The Commission shall be composed of 9 members appointed by the Secretary, of whom—

children.text: 1 member shall represent the Colorado State Director of the Bureau of Land Management;
1 member shall be the manager of the Alamosa National Wildlife Refuge, ex officio;
3 members shall be appointed based on the recommendation of the Governor of Colorado, of whom—
1 member shall represent the Colorado Division of Wildlife;
1 member shall represent the Colorado Division of Water Resources; and
1 member shall represent the Rio Grande Water Conservation District; and
be citizens of the local region in which the Natural Area is established; and
have knowledge and experience in the fields of interest relating to the preservation, restoration, and use of the Natural Area.

children.heading: In general
children.text: Except for the manager of the Alamosa National Wildlife Refuge, the term of office of a member of the Commission shall be 5 years.

children.heading: Reappointment
children.text: A member may be reappointed to the Commission on completion of the term of office of the member.

tree.heading: Compensation
tree.text: A member of the Commission shall serve without compensation for service on the Commission.

tree.heading: Chairperson
tree.text: The Commission shall elect a chairperson of the Commission.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Commission shall meet at least quarterly at the call of the chairperson.

children.heading: Public meetings
children.text: A meeting of the Commission shall be open to the public.

children.heading: Notice
children.text: Notice of any meeting of the Commission shall be published in advance of the meeting.

tree.heading: Technical assistance
tree.text: The Secretary and the heads of other Federal agencies shall, to the maximum extent practicable, provide any information and technical services requested by the Commission to assist in carrying out the duties of the Commission.
